## Change class

- [ ] Normative protocol or registry change
- [ ] Reference implementation or conformance tooling change
- [ ] Non-normative documentation, example, or project operation change

## Contract and evidence

- [ ] I linked the governing OFF Change Proposal or explained why one is not required.
- [ ] I identified compatibility, security, privacy, and clean-room effects.
- [ ] I kept `release/v0.1-rc.1/**` unchanged, or this pull request is explicitly preparing a new immutable candidate.
- [ ] I did not turn local validation into a claim of interoperability, adoption, independent review, or financial correctness.
- [ ] I added or updated the narrowest reliable tests, fixtures, schemas, catalog entries, and documentation.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Distinguish local checks from hosted or independent evidence.
